mapper.insert: INSERT INTO compute_spec (id, name, display_name, gpu_brand, default_gpu_count, default_gpumem_mb, default_gpucores, default_cpu_cores, default_memory_gib, node_selector, tolerations, resource_quota_key, memory_gb, description, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{id}, #{name}, #{displayName}, #{gpuBrand}, #{defaultGpuCount}, #{defaultGpumemMb}, #{defaultGpucores}, #{defaultCpuCores}, #{defaultMemoryGib}, #{nodeSelector}, #{tolerations}, #{resourceQuotaKey}, #{memoryGb}, #{description}, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM compute_spec ORDER BY gpu_brand, memory_gb DESC
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO physical_cluster_spec (physical_cluster_id, spec_id, total_count) KEY(physical_cluster_id, spec_id) VALUES (#{physicalClusterId}, #{specId}, #{totalCount})
MERGE INTO resource_pool_spec_quota (resource_pool_id, spec_id, total_quota, allocated_quota) KEY(resource_pool_id, spec_id) VALUES (#{resourcePoolId}, #{specId}, #{totalQuota}, #{allocatedQuota})
mapper.update: UPDATE resource_pool_spec_quota SET allocated_quota = #{allocatedQuota} WHERE resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId} AND spec_id = #{specId}
mapper.select: SELECT cs.name as spec_name, cs.id as spec_id, rpsq.total_quota, rpsq.allocated_quota, (rpsq.total_quota - rpsq.allocated_quota) as available FROM resource_pool_spec_quota rpsq JOIN compute_spec cs ON cs.id = rpsq.spec_id WHERE rpsq.resource_pool_id = #{resourcePoolId}
mapper.insert: MERGE INTO workspace_pool_spec_quota (workspace_id, resource_pool_id, spec_id, max_quota, used_quota) KEY(workspace_id, resource_pool_id, spec_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{resourcePoolId}, #{specId}, #{maxQuota}, #{usedQuota})
mapper.select: SELECT cs.name as spec_name, cs.id as spec_id, wpsq.resource_pool_id, wpsq.max_quota, wpsq.used_quota, (wpsq.max_quota - wpsq.used_quota) as available FROM workspace_pool_spec_quota wpsq JOIN compute_spec cs ON cs.id = wpsq.spec_id WHERE wpsq.workspace_id = #{workspaceId}
